risks.risk: Electrical output and working condition cannot be confirmed from photos
risks.proof: Video of the panel in sunlight connected to a multimeter or charge controller showing voltage and current

risks.risk: Wattage or power rating is not shown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the label on the back showing the wattage and model

risks.risk: Age or usage history is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturing date sticker or a video showing frame and cell condition
Photo or screenshot of a valid warranty card or document

risks.risk: Mounting hardware and cables may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of all cables, connectors, and mounting brackets included with the panel
Photo of the panel next to a tape measure or known object for scale

proof_requests: Close-up of the back label showing wattage, model, and date
Video of the panel producing power under sunlight with a multimeter
Photo of any cables, connectors, and mounting hardware included
Photo showing panel dimensions with a tape measure
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a solar panel, so a worst-case price is possible; output, rating, age, and accessories are unproven.
